findings.evidence: The invented 30% stockout reduction is attributed to "the weekly report" in the conclusion; weekly exception reporting is jd_2, while the finding targets jd_1 (SQL reconciliation).
findings.proposed_fix: Target jd_2 in the expected CF-EVIDENCE finding, or rewrite the false metric to refer specifically to the SQL reconciliation duty.

findings.evidence: jd_1 requires "Build a retrieval assistant prototype". fact_2 says only that a demo log records six staff test prompts and no production deployment; it does not attribute prototype construction to the candidate. The positive answer cites only jd_1 and fact_2 and labels the full build-and-test duty supported.
findings.proposed_fix: Remove [jd_1, fact_2] as a sufficient evidence set and have answer_02 cite fact_1 for candidate build ownership, optionally alongside fact_2 for documented testing; retain the production boundary.

findings.evidence: jd_1 states a valid Class B laboratory permit is mandatory when applying. No source says the employer can waive it. The second passing action asks for an explicit employer waiver of that minimum, making an unsupported discretionary path a model answer.
findings.proposed_fix: Use a second passing answer that maintains the pass decision, or add an explicit employer source stating that an exception process exists. If a clarification is retained, frame it as verifying the policy owner and applicability, not assuming a waiver is available.

findings.evidence: Both jd_1 and jd_2 are present and correctly labeled in the negative assessment. Its defect is the conclusion "The candidate meets every duty" despite jd_2 being unknown. The annotation calls this CF-COVERAGE and says it erases the duty, but the duty is still assessed.
findings.proposed_fix: Use CF-UNCERTAINTY or CF-ACTION for the overstated conclusion, or mutate the answer to actually omit the jd_2 assessment if CF-COVERAGE is the intended test.

findings.evidence: The atomic JD duty is "Lead the migration plan". fact_1 says another lead owned that plan, while the candidate owned a field-mapping checklist. A checklist contribution is relevant to the migration but is not itself a demonstrated subset of plan leadership; the gold nevertheless requires partial for jd_1.
findings.proposed_fix: Make jd_1 an explicit compound planning duty that includes field mapping and set kind to compound_duty, or mark leadership unproven while discussing the checklist as adjacent evidence without calling it partial leadership.

findings.evidence: jd_1 says applicants must have a paid audit within 18 months; the candidate reports only one 26 months ago. No employer source permits waiving that recency minimum, yet the second passing answer treats a waiver inquiry as an alternative action.
findings.proposed_fix: Keep both passing answers on a pass/reassess path unless the synthetic JD explicitly states an exception or waiver route. A second answer can vary evidence focus or next step without inventing employer discretion.

findings.evidence: jd_2 says "Preferred: facilitate developer workshops for external partners", a future/general capability. fact_2 says the candidate has not facilitated an external workshop; that establishes no prior history, but not inability to facilitate one. Gold and both positives label jd_2 contradicted, inconsistent with the suite boundary that absent past experience does not establish inability for a future duty.
findings.proposed_fix: Either change jd_2 to an explicit preference for prior external-workshop facilitation and keep contradicted, or change gold and positive labels to unknown while preserving the fact that no previous example is available.

findings.evidence: The negative still includes a supported assessment of jd_2, so the annotated CF-COVERAGE omission is not literal. The conclusion wrongly says the assumption-review duty "can be ignored"; that is a scope/decision error in the conclusion, not an omitted assessment.
findings.proposed_fix: Use CF-SCOPE for the explicit instruction to ignore a genuine JD duty, or remove jd_2 from the negative assessment and update changed_paths so CF-COVERAGE tests an actual omission.

review_note: Read-only semantic review of the 12 synthetic candidate-fit fixtures. Findings distinguish unsupported positive labels/evidence from narrower mutation-annotation mismatches; this review does not establish human-approved gold or a live model result.
